company.name: Benchling
company.shortDescription: Benchling is an IT company that provides a cloud-based software platform for biology researchers and research and development organizations.
company.description: Benchling is the modern software platform purpose-built for life science R&D. Hundreds of thousands of scientists using cutting-edge techniques like CRISPR, CAR-T immunotherapy, and genetic engineering depend on our suite of cloud applications to design DNA, collaborate on experiments, manage research workflows, and make critical R&D decisions.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based R&D workspace for designing experiments, managing biological entities and samples, capturing results, coordinating workflows, and analyzing research data.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling Bioresearch

productsAndServices.description: A process-development platform for recipe design, experiment planning, batch execution, process data capture, tech transfer, and analysis of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling Bioprocess

productsAndServices.description: An AI interface embedded in the Benchling notebook for searching R&D data, importing and structuring files, analyzing experiments, drafting reports, and running scientific models.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling AI

productsAndServices.description: An antibody and protein R&D product for configuring molecular formats, registering sequences, characterizing proteins, tracking lineage, and linking wet-lab and computational data.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling Biologics

productsAndServices.description: A laboratory automation product that connects instruments, orchestrates workflows, runs analysis, and records traceable results in the associated scientific record.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling Automation

productsAndServices.description: An instrument-connectivity product that transfers laboratory and R&D instrument data into structured Benchling records for downstream analysis and workflow use.
productsAndServices.name: Benchling Connect

aiResearchSummary.text: Benchling is researching methods, systems, and apparatus for visualizations of molecular sequences and structures and visualization of synthetically modified molecular nucleotide sequences, molecular sequence design tools for automatically generating molecular constructs, and component links in molecular databases. It is also developing a computing platform for bioprocess design, execution, analysis, and technology transfer, bioprocess execution workflow interfaces, chemical structure searching, and a machine learning life sciences research platform.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Benchling combines Benchling Bioresearch with Benchling AI.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
